intent_en: To illustrate how the presence of peacekeepers significantly reduces the likelihood of war reoccurring during the period 1989-2004.
previous_intent: To demonstrate the effect of peacekeepers in reducing the likelihood of war reoccurring to approximately a quarter of the baseline probability.
narration_support: War was about a quarter as likely to reoccur when peacekeepers were present.
chart_support: A bar chart titled 'Likelihood of war reoccurring' displays a low probability value (visually a short white segment on a 0.00-1.00 scale) with the subtitle 'Effect of peacekeepers, 1989-2004'.
evidence_note: The narration quantifies the reduction as 'a quarter', while the chart visualizes this as a low likelihood (24%) under the specific timeframe of peacekeeper deployment.
